mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and inhibit cardiac repolarization, increasing risk of torsades de pointes; amiodarone inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing prochlorperazine levels.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, monitor ECG closely, correct electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), reduce prochlorperazine dose, and monitor for arrhythmias.
